projectName.description: The app's name in the editors and in contact sheets.

bundleId.description: The iOS bundle id, for App Store Connect.

defaultLocale.description: The language other languages start from, and whose copy and captures fill gaps.

locales.description: Every App Store language the app's screenshots and listing are made in (e.g. en-US, de-DE).

content.description: The copy, one file per language.

raw.description: The captures, by device family and language.

assets.description: Fonts, logos, backgrounds and layer art.

outputScreenshots.description: Where the App Store screenshots go, for fastlane `deliver`.

outputPlay.description: Google Play (`supply`) metadata root; screenshots go under <locale>/images/phoneScreenshots/.

metadata.description: The store text, one folder per language, for fastlane `deliver`.

generated.description: Pages, iPhone Duo, header and search images, events, contact sheets; not committed.

previews.description: App Preview videos, <previews>/<locale>/*.mp4|m4v|mov; readiness checks them and `asc push default` uploads them.

paths.description: Where the tool reads and writes, relative to the app; the defaults suit nearly every app.

targets.description: The devices to render for, by id (`iphone-6.9-1320x2868`, `header-3840x1646`, ...).

sourceDevices.description: target id -> raw capture device folder name under paths.raw

family.description: The font family, as Google Fonts names it, or a family added locally.

source.description: Where `store-shots fonts add` gets it from.

weights.description: The weights downloaded; headlines use the heaviest a headline font lists.

fallbacks.description: Extra families tried after `family`, in order (must be local: `fonts add`). Bundled fallbacks are appended automatically.

family.description: The font family, as Google Fonts names it, or a family added locally.

source.description: Where `store-shots fonts add` gets it from.

weights.description: The weights downloaded; headlines use the heaviest a headline font lists.

fallbacks.description: Extra families tried after `family`, in order (must be local: `fonts add`). Bundled fallbacks are appended automatically.

headlineFont.description: Optional display face for headlines (e.g. a serif); body copy keeps `font`.

background.description: Any CSS background: a colour, a gradient, several layered.

backgroundImage.description: Over the background: "asset:<file in store/assets>", "pattern:<waves, dots, grid, lines, zigzag, rings, crosses, checker or noise>", or "none".

patternColor.description: Line colour of a pattern (any CSS colour; noise ignores it).

patternScale.description: Size of a pattern's tiles, 0.25 to 4 times the default.

span.description: Stretch the project-default background across the whole screenshot strip (each screen shows its slice).

background.description: Project-wide default background; screens inherit it unless they override (backgroundImage "none" opts out of a texture).

primary.description: The brand colour: the default background, and Full Bleed Card's card.

accent.description: Colour for the eyebrow and caption (a sub-line in a second colour); default: the text colour.

brand.description: The app's look: fonts, colours and the default background. A theme sets these.

format.description: The file format; PNG only for now.

backgroundColor.description: The colour transparency is flattened onto, since the stores refuse alpha.

cleanBeforeRender.description: A full run deletes the files of the last run that are no longer planned.

strictTranslations.description: A missing translation is an error (true) or a warning (false).

failOnOverflow.description: Text that overflows at its smallest allowed size is an error (true) or a warning.

failOnAlpha.description: A rendered file with transparency is an error (true) or a warning.

failOnTextOverlap.description: Text overlapping the device shell is a warning by default (designers do it on purpose); true makes it an error.

screensPerTarget.description: How many screenshots each device and language should have (Apple takes 1 to 10).

manage.description: The tool edits and checks the store text; false leaves it to you.

fields.description: The fields Listing shows and readiness requires.

presets.description: Named override presets applied to screens from the editor ("apply preset").

state.description:
AsyncStorage entries written into the simulator's app container before
each capture run, so screens never show an empty streak or onboarding.
Values are stored as JSON; strings are written through unchanged.
`{today}` and `{today-N}` in any string resolve to YYYY-MM-DD at run
time, which keeps a seeded streak from going stale between runs.

storageDir.description: Folder under Library/Application Support/<bundleId> that holds AsyncStorage.

appleLanguages.description: App Store locale -> iOS AppleLanguages value, when the two differ.

settleSeconds.description: Seconds to wait after opening a deep link before the screenshot.

languageSettleSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for SpringBoard after switching the simulator language.

capture.description: Automated capture: how to put the simulator into a known state (plan section 7.5).

blender.description: Path to the Blender binary (default: $BLENDER, /Applications/Blender.app, or `blender` on PATH).

id.description: The step's name, for `scenes render <step>` and `needs`.

blender.description: Run as `blender -b --factory-startup` with this script; its arguments follow `--`.

python.description: Run with `python3 -I`; its arguments are the usual sys.argv[1:].

args.description: `{root}`, `{work}` and `{assets}` are replaced with absolute paths.

inputs.description: Files or folders that re-run the step when they change (the script's folder always does).

outputs.description: Files the step writes; a missing one re-runs it.

needs.description: Earlier steps whose output it reads: when one runs, so does this. Default: every earlier step.

scenes.description: The art pipeline behind store/assets: Blender renders and their post-processing, in order.

enabled.description: False turns off the lanes and the credentials check.

validate.description: Checks the store text against the limits.

fastlane.description: The app's own fastlane lanes the tool may run. It never runs one that builds or submits.
